about: Case 92 carried on: two batches, each with one approved unit named u1 in its own record file. `pointers` reads each unit from its batch's record file (b1-u1 from {run-id}-b1.json, b2-u1 from {run-id}-b2.json) and writes both pointers in the one Brain Dump doc, which is written once. Both become pointer-written. The run is at pointed with batch staying at 2. The real Edit guard gives [].
